people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Priest, father of John the Baptist

translations.web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
translations.bsb: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
